facts.fact: 父亲的旧庞蒂亚克火鸟还停在车库一侧等修复，永远等不到了。
facts.anchor: Dad’s first car had been a used Pontiac Firebird—“Like Rockford used to drive.”

facts.fact: 母亲坚持要 Oak Bay 地址；父亲是家庭医生，家里是拆战后平房建八十年代殖民风的中产配置。
facts.anchor: Mom had insisted on an Oak Bay address.

facts.fact: Meg 想到 Zak 回家照顾父亲，自嘲幸运：母亲的「病」只是固执己见、还总能证明自己对。
facts.anchor: I had a flash of Zak moving home to look after his father and reminded myself that I was lucky to have a parent whose only affliction was an obstinate belief that she was always right—along with a distressing ability to prove it.

facts.fact: 假期第一天去公司被告知晋升落选给 Cameron；她当面指出是性别歧视，HR 无能为力。
facts.anchor: I’d gone in to work Monday, on my first day of vacation, to be told “Maybe next time,” about the promotion I’d applied for.

facts.fact: 同一个周一她把离婚最终文件交给 Joel，自嘲是最后一次给他当无偿私人助理。
facts.anchor: In other ways, Monday had been the happiest day of my life. I had handed Joel the certified paperwork on our divorce.

facts.fact: 晚饭桌上她用宣布怀孕与离婚的同款开场白直接摊牌：辞职替 Georgia 看店到手术康复。
facts.anchor: It was the same way I had opened my announcements that I was pregnant and that I was getting a divorce. I tore that bandage right off. “I’m quitting my job.

facts.fact: Georgia 的脊椎肿瘤初判良性，但手术在脊椎、术后能否走路未知，公立医疗排队漫长。
facts.anchor: “They’re still doing tests, but they’re pretty sure it’s benign. They’re hoping she’ll be able to walk after the surgery, but it’s spinal surgery.”

facts.fact: 母亲改口说「我们」——不能坐视 Meg 拿自己与 Georgia 的未来冒险；Meg 反讽「你要去成人玩具店上班吗」，母亲叫她别贫。
facts.anchor: “We?” Record scratch. “You want to work in an adult toy shop, Mom?”
